cells.text: This version first released with RII Resources and Infrastructure Industry Training Package Version 7.0.

items.text: The following provides the packaging rules for this qualification, followed by the list of relevant units of competency.
at least 2 must be from Group B
no more than 4 may be from Group C
no more than 1 may be from Group D
no more than 2 may be from elsewhere in this or any other currently endorsed training package, or from an accredited course.

Elective units must be relevant to the work environment and the qualification, maintain the overall integrity of the AQF alignment, not duplicate the outcome of another unit chosen for the qualification, and contribute to a valid industry-supported vocational outcome.

The elective bank contains both licensed and non-licensed units of competency relating to high risk work in the resources and infrastructure industry. To be appointed under any statutory requirements in related roles, units of competency should be selected to meet the state/territory licensing requirements.
There are no prerequisites to imported units listed in this qualification. Where a unit is imported as an elective care must be taken to ensure that all prerequisites specified are complied with.

cells.text: Apply, monitor and report on compliance systems
Implement and monitor WHS policies, procedures and programs
Respond to local emergencies and incidents
Apply and monitor emergency preparedness and response systems in surface operations
Apply and monitor systems for stable mining
Apply and monitor systems and methods of surface coal mining
Apply and monitor the ground control management plan
Monitor interaction of heavy and light vehicles and mining equipment
Apply and monitor mine services and infrastructure systems
Apply and monitor site plant and resource management plan
Apply and monitor the site stockpile management plan
Monitor quarry laboratory operations and the quality of results
Apply and monitor site waste and by-products management plan
Apply and monitor the site water management plan
Plan finances for new business ventures
Support the learning and development of teams and individuals
Ensure a safe workplace for a work area
Monitor and control the effects of blasting on the environment
Develop and maintain positive community relations
Provide leadership in the supervision of diverse work teams
Apply a quality management system on site
Implement and maintain management systems to control risk
Apply site plant, equipment and infrastructure maintenance management plans
